title: Prospective Chess-Structure→Search Pair-Mediation Bridge, Legal-Pair-Preserving Board Interventions, Susceptibility-State Causality, Cross-Engine Mediation Transport & Preference-Explanation Reconstitution

origin_lock.founding_explanandum: why one legal move is marginally preferred over a near-equal alternative beyond obvious tactical dominance
origin_lock.p15_role: return from replicated exact search-event pair-edge causality to a chess-board structural cause of that preference boundary
origin_lock.terminal_object: a prospectively matched chess-board edit -> exact semantic search susceptibility -> unordered legal-move pair preference bridge
origin_lock.anti_drift: a finer MOVE_ORDER_SEED taxonomy, telemetry catalogue, or implementation detail is not a P15 success unless it changes the chess move-vs-move contrast

two_track_boundary.science_mainline: novel causal/contrastive identification of marginal strategic preference
two_track_boundary.explanation_implementation: PGN-to-commentary engineering may borrow external methods but cannot enlarge P15 scientific authority

source_freshness.policy: reuse completed July/August provider bytes only as source containers; every P15 target and decoy position must be hash-disjoint from all recoverable P1-P14 positions

fresh_worlds.eligibility: standard legal nonterminal chess; not in check; plies 14-27; 18-48 legal moves; absolute material imbalance <=3 pawns; target/decoy hashes disjoint from recoverable P1-P14 corpus hashes

unordered_pair_constitution.canonical_pair_id: lexicographically sorted UCI pair joined by ::; lexical A/B is reconstruction only
unordered_pair_constitution.engine_support_for_pair: both moves stable for that engine, absolute isolated cp gap <=50, contextual shared-search bestmove is inside the pair
unordered_pair_constitution.pair_admission: at least two engines support the same unordered pair at the same fresh position

board_intervention_grammar.intervention_unit: single quiet relocation of one non-king, non-pawn piece that is not the moving piece of either frozen candidate
board_intervention_grammar.legal_counterfactual_semantics: valid chess state with unchanged side to move and material; historical reachability is not claimed
board_intervention_grammar.forbidden_touch_squares: neither relocation source nor destination may equal either candidate move source/destination square
board_intervention_grammar.relocation_destination: empty square contained in that piece's occupancy-aware attack set on the original board; no capture
board_intervention_grammar.castling_rights_guard: do not relocate a rook carrying a current castling right
pair_preservation: both frozen candidate moves remain legal
resulting board is not in check
board_intervention_grammar.pair_local_relation_vector: for the relocated piece, four booleans: attacks A.from, A.to, B.from, B.to
board_intervention_grammar.TARGET_EDIT: pair-local relation vector changes and the changed bits are asymmetric between candidate A endpoints and candidate B endpoints
board_intervention_grammar.target_sham_matching: same moved piece identity and same Chebyshev relocation distance; otherwise the candidate edit pair is inadmissible
board_intervention_grammar.engine_relative_relation_delta_role: after board-edit freeze, lexical A/B delta counts are re-expressed per engine as ANCHOR_DISPREFERRED_DOMINANT, ANCHOR_PREFERRED_DOMINANT, or BALANCED using that engine's original-board baseline orientation; lexical A/B is not a replication signature

board_edit_marginality_freeze.per_engine_support: on BOTH target and matched sham boards, both frozen pair moves remain legal and have two exactly repeated non-mate isolated cp scores with absolute pair gap <=50
board_edit_marginality_freeze.edit_pair_admission: the SAME target/sham edit pair is supported by at least two engines that were active on the frozen original pair
selection_order: minimum maximum edited pair gap across target/sham/engines

exact_event_mediator.semantic_anchor: the pair member that was BASELINE_DISPREFERRED on the original B0 board for this engine
exact_event_mediator.per_board_addressing: native private event addresses are reconstituted separately on B0, TARGET, and SHAM; no address identity across boards or engines is assumed
exact_event_mediator.target_selection: within each board and bound, choose the lexicographically smallest eligible exact event mapped to the original anchor-dispreferred candidate; at most one per bound
exact_event_mediator.intervention: T_ONLY exact semantic-use removal; TT storage/replacement/index/age untouched

factorial.primary_comparison: B0_ORIGINAL vs B1_TARGET crossed with NATIVE vs T_ONLY

susceptibility_states.NO_EVENT: no eligible anchor event for the bound on that board
susceptibility_states.EVENT_NULL: eligible event fires and T_ONLY leaves the native root choice unchanged
susceptibility_states.EVENT_PAIR_REVERSAL: eligible event fires and T_ONLY selects the other frozen pair member
susceptibility_states.EVENT_THIRD_ESCAPE: eligible event fires and T_ONLY selects outside the frozen pair

operational_mediation.language_rule: P15 uses operational mechanistic mediation/interaction, not Pearl natural direct/indirect effects or cross-world counterfactual mediation

classes.FULL_BRIDGE: TARGET changes native pair orientation relative to B0; at least one shared bound has fired events on both boards; T_ONLY collapses the B0-vs-TARGET native pair difference to the same frozen pair member; SHAM does not reproduce the same collapse pattern
classes.SUSCEPTIBILITY_MODULATION: TARGET changes exact-event susceptibility state relative to B0 for a shared bound while pair legality/marginality is preserved; FULL_BRIDGE not met
classes.DIRECT_BOARD_ONLY: TARGET changes native pair orientation but exact-event removal does not collapse or account for that difference
classes.SEARCH_ONLY_NO_BOARD_LINK: exact-event intervention affects pair preference but TARGET does not differ from B0 beyond SHAM-matched behavior

required_fields: exact target and sham board edits
per-engine isolated pair gaps on all three boards

claim_ceiling: P15 may identify prospectively matched low-collateral board structural perturbations that modulate exact-event susceptibility and near-equal legal-pair preference under the declared engines and budgets.
FULL_BRIDGE is an operational factorial interaction/collapse result, not a natural direct/indirect effect decomposition.
A pair-local attack-relation delta is a mechanistic board descriptor, not yet a human strategic concept such as space, initiative, prophylaxis, or piece quality.
Semantic event transport does not imply native address or algorithm identity across boards or engines.
Engine preference is not objective chess truth, human intent, cognition, or normative move quality.
Historically unreachable but rule-valid counterfactual boards are structural probes, not claims about natural game frequency.
forbidden: No P14 position or witness may vote in P15 confirmation.
No retrospective promotion of P14 reciprocal geometry.
No post-outcome human concept naming as a P15 causal variable.
No board edit may touch a candidate move source/destination square or alter material.
No board-edit selection using native edited-board bestmove or T_ONLY outcomes.
No silent authority transfer from the explanation-implementation track.
stop_rule: Run the frozen P15 fresh campaign once. If the board grammar or support gates fail, report that structural-probe ceiling rather than tuning relation deltas, collateral thresholds, pair-gap thresholds, event subclasses, or bridge definitions after outcomes.
